metadata.datasource: Measured off Kodak Alaris F-4001 (revised 04/2019), KODAK PROFESSIONAL T-MAX P3200 Black & White Negative Film / 3200TMZ, T-MAX Developer, small tank, 12 min at 20 C, Kodak's time for EI 3200, interpolated between the published 11 and 13 minute curves along exposure at each density (bitmaps, traced); diffuse visual density. Characteristic curve laid on agx's axis with mid-grey where a meter set to EI 3200 puts it on the sheet's absolute axis (log H -2.595); the curve's own ISO speed point is ISO 1447; base + fog 0.366. Continued at its final gradient for 0.8 decades past the last plotted exposure. Spectral sensitivity: the D = 1.0 over D-min curve (equal-energy, erg/cm^2, effective exposure 1.4 s, D-76 at 20 C), which runs off the plot at 670 nm, two decades down. One silver layer, carried as three identical channels.
